pressure_definition: death = final five scheduled/revised overs; chase RRR >=10; collapse = >=3 wickets lost in first 30% (maximum six overs) OR >=5 wickets lost before 75% of innings; clutch chase = <=30 balls and <=50 runs remaining; bowling additionally includes partnerships >=50
correction: Dismissal counts used for batting average and pressure average are keyed by match format and player ID to avoid mixing IPL and T20I dismissal totals.
